summary_1line: Bhishma consciously releases his life through yogic control, is cremated with royal rites, and Krishna consoles the grieving goddess Ganga about her son’s heavenly fate.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on the bed of arrows as his life-breath rises through the crown of his head like a blazing meteor ascending into the sky.
Celestial drums sound and flowers rain from the heavens as sages and Krishna watch Bhishma’s spirit ascend.
The river goddess Ganga rises from the waters in sorrow, lamenting her fallen son before Krishna gently consoles her.
